verified_key_information_units.information: Russia contributed €15.8m (55.1% of sales) flat in EUR but down 7.8% in local currency with store count reducing to 67; Belarus grew 6.4% to €9.0m; Ukraine sales collapsed 58.3% to €15k.
verified_key_information_units.source_evidence: Management Report: 'The Group’s sales on the Russian market totalled 15 767 thousand EUR, decrease is 0.6% compared to 06 months of 2025... Local currency sales decreased by 7.8%... At the end of the reporting period, there were a total of 67 stores... Belarus... sales... increased by 6.4%... The Group’s sales in Ukraine... decreased by 58.3%...'; Sales by markets table.

candidate_sentences.text: Geographically, the Group’s largest market, Russia, saw sales decrease by 0.6% to 15,767 thousand EUR, with local currency sales falling by 7.8%.
Belarus remained a strong performer, with sales increasing by 6.4% to 9,046 thousand EUR and local currency sales rising by 2.7%.
Sales in Ukraine plummeted by 58.3% to just 15 thousand EUR, while the Baltics and other markets also experienced declines of 16.7% and 5.1% respectively.

verified_key_information_units.information: Gross margin improved to 55.6% (from 53.1%), operating margin fell to 20.1% (from 21.0%), EBITDA margin 26.3% (from 26.6%), and net margin attributable to parent declined to 13.9% (from 20.3%).
verified_key_information_units.source_evidence: Selected Financial Indicators table: 'Gross profit margin... 55.6% from 53.1%... Operating profit margin... 20.1% from 21.0%... EBITDA margin... 26.3% from 26.6%... Net profit margin attributable to equity holders of the Parent company... 13.9% against 20.3%...'

candidate_sentences.text: The net profit margin attributable to parent company equity holders contracted sharply from 20.3% to 13.9%.
This resulted in an expanded gross margin of 55.6%, up from 53.1% in the previous year.
However, operating profit declined by 3.5% to 5,751 thousand EUR, with the operating profit margin narrowing from 21.0% to 20.1%.
EBITDA also saw a slight reduction of 0.8%, settling at 7,508 thousand EUR with a margin of 26.3%.

verified_key_information_units.information: Operating cash flow surged 96.6% to €6.8m, boosting cash and cash equivalents by 87.4% to €12.4m.
verified_key_information_units.source_evidence: Selected Financial Indicators: 'Operating cash flow for the period 6 842 (2025: 3 481)... Cash and cash equivalents 12 443 (2025: 6 639)'; Note 2 Cash and cash equivalents.

candidate_sentences.text: The Group maintained strong liquidity, with cash and cash equivalents nearly doubling by 87.4% to 12,443 thousand EUR.
Operating cash flow surged by 96.6% to 6,842 thousand EUR, reflecting improved cash generation despite lower net profits.

verified_key_information_units.information: Total assets grew 5.1% to €98.6m with equity attributable to parent up 6.1% to €81.5m, while current liabilities decreased €1.0m.
verified_key_information_units.source_evidence: Selected Financial Indicators: 'Total assets 98 603 (2025: 93 847)... candidate_sentences.text: Financial position remained robust with total assets increasing by 5.1% to 98,603 thousand EUR.
Equity attributable to equity holders of the Parent company grew by 6.1% to 81,479 thousand EUR.

verified_key_information_units.information: Management emphasized improving retail profitability and expanding retail stores in Russia contingent on securing reasonably priced locations.
verified_key_information_units.source_evidence: Russia Economic Outlook: 'Group will focus on improving profitability of its retail business, we will also continue to expand our store chain there depending on the availability of reasonably priced sales areas.'

details.completeness_justification: The candidate summary adequately represents the core material meaning of K1-K6, K9, and K10, covering revenue, profitability, margin changes, geographic performance, cash flow, and employee data. However, K7 (management's strategic emphasis on retail profitability and store expansion) and K8 (inventory and trade receivables movements) are entirely missing. Despite these omissions, the majority of high-importance financial data is captured, justifying a 'Generally yes' score.
details.coherence_justification: The candidate summary is fully coherent internally. All statements are logically connected and support each other without contradiction. The summary follows a clear structure: consolidated performance overview (S1-S5), revenue drivers by channel and geography (S10-S15), and financial position/cash flow details (S16-S22). Explanations and comparisons are consistent throughout (e.g., gross margin expansion aligns with decreased COGS, operating profit decline is contextualized by margin contraction). No arithmetic contradictions are present, and differences between segment/consolidated figures are not claimed to be directly additive. There is no unnecessary repetition, and the narrative flows logically from revenue to profitability to cash flow and balance sheet metrics.
